name: Between Two Points
source:
Between Two Points is a story-driven visual novel about fate, death, and the fragile balance of the universe.

The story follows Lyra as she begins to uncover the truth behind Gaodrassil, a mysterious tree said to hold the souls of the dead. When the balance surrounding it begins to shift, events unfold that may reshape reality itself.

[From [url=https://amonielove.itch.io/betweentwopoints]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《两点之间》是一部故事驱动的视觉小说，讲述命运、死亡和宇宙脆弱的平衡。

故事讲述莱拉开始揭开高达希尔背后的真相，高达希尔是一棵神秘的树，据说可以容纳死者的灵魂。当周围的平衡开始发生变化时，事件的展开可能会重塑现实本身。

[来自[url=https://amonielove.itch.io/betweentwopoints]itch.io[/url]]
